scenario.name: CISA/NSA/FBI Telecom Guidance, GSMA FS.31 & ENISA 5G — 5G Core Service-Based Interface (SBI) NRF/UDM & Diameter Roaming Audit
scenario.overview: Imagine a live television and radio broadcast studio with a glowing red ON AIR sign, a soundproof control-room window, a sliding mixing console, and a rooftop signal dish. Slipping into the broadcast control room beside the soundproof glass window, an unlisted engineer patches a covert jumper cord straight into the live mixing console. In this real-world scenario, the intruder approaches the soundproof on air studio door disguised as a regular visitor, then moves quietly past the soundproof on air studio door into neighboring restricted rooms. The master control broadcast log spots an unscheduled auxiliary transmitter channel pulling signal off the mixing board and cuts the rogue patch. In this scenario (T1528, CISA/NSA/FBI Telecom Guidance, GSMA FS.31 & ENISA 5G - 5G Core Service-Based Interface , SBI NRF/UDM & Diameter Roaming Audit), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: 5G NRF NFRegister, then uDM Subscriber Data, then diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering 5G NRF NFRegister, then UDM Subscriber Data, then Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection pivots on Suricata Event 200 correlated across the documented kill chain.

stages.title: Stage 2: UDM Subscriber Data & Serving AMF/gNodeB Location Query (/nudm-sdm/v2/)
stages.subtitle: Collection (T1557 - Adversary-in-the-Middle)
stages.description: As the red ON AIR sign lights up above the studio floor, the covert bridge silently mirrors every studio feed up to the spinning rooftop signal dish. Here in Step 2 inside the broadcast studio, the intruder smuggles copied records out past the soundproof on air studio door in tiny disguised batches without disturbing the backup emergency transmitter. stages.title: Stage 3: Diameter S6a Insert-Subscriber-Data (IDR) & SEPP Interconnect Anomaly Correlation
stages.subtitle: Discovery (T1046 - Network Service Discovery)
